hero.title: ExtraPawn — The Chess Gym for Serious Players
hero.subtitle: A complete preparation ecosystem for tournament players (1500+)

what.title: What is it?
what.text: **ExtraPawn** is a professional training environment where every module flows logically into the next. Not just a place for puzzles, but a full-fledged gym designed to bridge the gap between amateur play and Grandmaster-level preparation.

forWho.title: For Whom?
forWho.text: For those stuck on a plateau who want real progress. ExtraPawn doesn't teach the basic rules — it digitizes your weaknesses and eliminates them systematically.

uniqueness.title: What makes us unique?
uniqueness.text: The market is flooded with disconnected tools. ExtraPawn combines everything into a **single closed-loop training cycle**: Build your repertoire → Test it in sparring → Hone the realization → Analyze weaknesses → Fix. All modules sync progress in one unified dashboard.

trainingCenter.title: TRAINING CENTER — 7 / 30-Day Course System
trainingCenter.text:
Structured training courses across four core disciplines (**Tactics, Theoretical Endgames, Practical Chess, Finish Him**) divided into three progression tiers (**Novice, Pro, Master**).

• **Dual-Gate Progression**: Unlocking the next tier requires completing the course puzzle quota and clearing the Glicko-2 rating gate across all mandatory scopes.
• **Intelligent Coach Sidebar**: Live move evaluation, visual strategic plans, and blunder protection.
• **Neural Playouts**: In Endgames and Finish Him, transition seamlessly from forced lines into full conversion playouts against human-like neural network systems (Maia 1500, Maia 2200, MOZERO).

warmup.title: TARGETED WARMUP — Precision Calibration Arena
warmup.text:
Free-form training arena for rapid warmups and surgical weakness elimination without course schedule constraints.

• 🎯 **Granular Focus Contours**: Filter by combat motif contour, specific tactical motif, game phase, calculation horizon, endgame domain, or material class.
• 📊 **Blind-Spot Calibration**: Rapidly reduce rating deviation (RD) and bring lagging scopes above the tier gate.
• ⚡ **Full Rating Sync**: Every attempt updates your Glicko-2 skill profile and cabinet analytics in real time.

woodpecker.title: WOODPECKER METHOD — 24h Cooldown · 3× Streak
woodpecker.text:
Automated spaced-repetition engine inspired by the classic Woodpecker Method.

• ⏳ **24-Hour Cooldown**: Any failed puzzle is automatically placed in the Woodpecker vault for a 24-hour cooldown to reset short-term memory.
• 🔥 **3× Consecutive Streak**: To graduate a puzzle permanently, you must solve it cleanly 3 times in a row across separate 24h+ intervals.
• 🧠 **Pattern Reflexes**: Turns former tactical and endgame blind spots into instant tournament reflexes.

userCabinet.title: USER CABINET 2.0 — Your Chess DNA
userCabinet.text:
Visual command center for macro progress and automated diagnostics.

• 📈 **12-Month Mastery Timeline**: Rolling 52-week Glicko-2 rating and EMA accuracy trajectory.
• 🧭 **Tactical Radar & Endgame Map**: Full breakdown across every motif, domain, material class, and calculation horizon (Short 1-2m vs Deep 3+m).
• 🚀 **One-Click Action**: Automatically identifies your top strength, primary gate blocker, and high-RD blind spots with one-click WarmUp launch.

techStack.chessEngineStack: Stockfish 19 (Server & WASM), LCZero (Maia 1500, Maia 2200, MOZERO Neural Hub)

neuralNetworks.title: MOZERO Sparring System & Neural Hub
neuralNetworks.text: Realistic sparring is powered by the human-like **Maia** series (1500 and 2200 Elo) and the hybrid **MOZERO** system built on the standard **lc0_32_1** engine, **Elite-Leela-v2-128x10x8h-1704000.pb.gz** weights, and a dedicated **Python + Syzygy & Gaviota** orchestration layer. Special thanks to the author of the **CallOn84/LeelaNets** repository for publishing the neural network weights.
